Application Data.NAME: Gallery 21 Fine Arts
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Gallery 21 Fine Arts operates as a premier art gallery and supply store, showcasing a curated selection of original artworks, prints, and art supplies from local and international artists. We provide a vibrant space for community engagement through art exhibitions, workshops, and educational programs aimed at promoting art appreciation. Our inventory is regularly appraised and maintained under strict climate control to prevent damage. The gallery features advanced security systems, including 24/7 surveillance and alarm monitoring, to mitigate risks of theft and vandalism. Additionally, we comply with all local regulations regarding the safe handling and storage of art supplies, including aerosol-based products.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On February 5, 2023, a water leak in the gallery caused damage to several artworks. The leak was due to a malfunctioning HVAC system. The estimated loss was $2,500.00. The claim was filed, and the status is currently closed after reimbursement from the maintenance provider.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade I, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: 24-hour security patrols and perimeter fencing with monitored CCTV surveillance.
